term: occurring borne thought as an intellectual exercise
definition: For every b and e, Occurs e and Bears b e imply attribution of e as an intellectual exercise of b in the supplied q75 OperationAttribution. This does not follow merely from Occurs or Bears; an impersonal event or content bearer need not exercise intellect.
note: Analyst interface for the separate conditional operation route in #1113, reusing DEF-Q75-OPERATION-ATTRIBUTION. Exact historical attribution is deferred. It is not the causation-only OperationOnlyOfBeingInActReading and is not an additional recorded root premise; see docs/notes/cogito-esse-1113.md.
